summary: New York-based low-fare airline, with its biggest base at JFK.
checkin: Check-in, and adding bags, opens 24 hours before departure.
baggage: Every fare, including Blue Basic, includes a carry-on that fits in the overhead bin plus a personal item. Checked bag prices depend on the travel date (peak or off-peak).
tips: Add bags at least 24 hours before departure to save $10 on each of your first 2 checked bags.
Eligible Mosaic members and some JetBlue cardholders get free checked bags.
